{{Quote|I see three flaws, Major. You've split your forces. You're vulnerable in the air. And you take our enemy for idiots. You think that Jedi isn't expecting this?|Grand Moff Regus scolds one of his officers during the battle for [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]|audio=Regus-ThreeFlaws-TOR.flac|<ref name="First Strike" />}}
'''Ilyan Regus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and head of [[Battle of Ilum|Operation Dark Ice]], a plan to use the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to develop stealth technology for the Empire. However, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] stood in the way, bringing in [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] shock troopers to harass Imperial operations. Though Kaedan was killed, he had tasked [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] mercenaries to guard the Empire's only crystal mine. Regus desired to have the Kaleesh army destroyed, but [[Darth Malgus]] reminded that the "victory" on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] cost nearly a tenth of Imperial forces and that it'd be a waste of resources, and suggested challenging the Kaleesh leader to win their loyalty, an idea that Regus was firmly opposed to.<ref name="The Challenge of War">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|The Challenge of War|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

Though the crystals were secured, the fleet needed to land safely and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] anti-air guns were preventing that. Though the guns were destroyed and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shai]] defeated, Malgus chose to betray the Empire to create his own. Regus convened an emergency war council to discuss what to do about Malgus.<ref name="An Empire Betrayed">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|An Empire Betrayed|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grand Moff Regus was voiced in the [[Star Wars video games|MMO videogame]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by actor [[Julian Sands]].
